subject: AWS Private Offer — pricing bands, term length, and approver roster for Helium Analytics
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@heliumanalytics.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-05-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AWS Private Offer — pricing bands, term length, and approver roster for Helium Analytics

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our discussion I wanted to capture a straightforward private-offer proposal and a couple of open questions so procurement can loop in the right approvers:

Summary proposal (seller-side):
- SKU: Redwood Inference — Standard Inference (reserved capacity)
- Pricing band A (12 mo): 18% discount vs list for > $200k ARR
- Pricing band B (18 mo): 22% discount vs list for > $350k ARR
- Pricing band C (24 mo): 25% discount + 2 months free (annualized) for > $650k ARR
- Billing: monthly invoice via AWS Marketplace (private offer activation)

Open questions for Helium procurement:
1) Who is the minimum approval roster? We typically need: primary procurement contact, IT security reviewer, CFO signoff (or delegated finance approver). If you can share names + emails we’ll include them on the DocuSign and the AWS approval flow.
2) Preferred term length: you mentioned finance prefers 18–24 months. Which band should we prioritize?
3) Compliance evidence: do you need the full SOC 2 package, or is the SOC2_summary and audit contact sufficient for initial approval?

I’ve attached a compact pricing sheet and a SOC2 summary; happy to iterate. If this looks reasonable I’ll draft the private offer on the AWS seller console and circulate for your approvers to review.

Next actions:
- Sara: confirm approver roster and preferred term band by EOD Tue 5/18
- Karthik: draft seller-side private offer and pricing sheet once approver list is provided

Thanks —
Karthik
Lead, Marketplace Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@heliumanalytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@heliumanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-05-17T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Private Offer — pricing bands, term length, and approver roster for Helium Analytics

Karthik —

Appreciate the clear options. Quick answers from procurement side:
- Approver roster (minimal):
  - Sara Liu, Procurement Director (sara.liu@heliumanalytics.com) — primary procurement
  - Tom Reyes, Head of IT (tom.reyes@heliumanalytics.com) — security/ops reviewer
  - Daniel Park, VP Finance (daniel.park@heliumanalytics.com) — CFO signoff (may delegate)

- Preferred term: finance is leaning to 18 months but will confirm if 24 months is acceptable if we get the deeper discount in band C.

- Compliance evidence: Start with SOC2_summary.pdf and the auditor contact (I can share the full report under NDA if required later). For now the summary + auditor email should be fine.

Please include the approver emails on the DocuSign envelope and route the AWS private-offer activation to sara.liu and daniel.park as approvers.

Thanks —
Sara
Director, Procurement
Helium Analytics

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@heliumanalytics.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Private Offer — pricing bands, term length, and approver roster for Helium Analytics

Sara —

Perfect, thanks for the roster. I drafted the seller-side structure and uploaded a private-offer draft to the AWS console (offer id: 0a1b2c3d) and attached our pricing workbook for your review (private_offer_pricing_sheet.xlsx). A few notes on the draft:

- I set the initial activation to the 18-month band (Pricing band B) with a conditional escalator to band C if total committed spend exceeds $650k in the first 12 months. That preserves finance preference for 18 months while giving them the price path if they accelerate usage.
- We listed Sara + Daniel as approvers in the AWS approval workflow; Tom is listed as the security contact for the evidence pack.
- DocuSign: I will send the DocuSign envelope to the approver list after you confirm whether Daniel will delegate to a finance manager.

Internal note: Naomi / Vanessa — please review the escalator clause and confirm we can implement the automatic pricing band upgrade in the private-offer terms (we do this by updating the entitlement SKU and firing a one-time credit if threshold met). Need legal sign-off if the escalator has an audit trigger.

Sara — could you confirm Daniel’s delegate (if any) and whether your legal team needs a redline before we go to DocuSign? If not, I’ll send the DocuSign today and kick the AWS approval flow.

Best —
Karthik

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Private Offer — pricing bands, term length, and approver roster for Helium Analytics

Karthik / Vanessa —

Quick internal approval: operations and finance are comfortable with the 18-month primary band + conditional escalator to 24 months pricing band (credit model). A couple of operational caveats:

1) Escalator mechanics: we’ll implement as a retrospective invoice credit (monthly scan for cumulative usage) — that avoids changing SKU mid-term. Ops will need the monthly usage export to validate the credit.
2) Audit trigger: any credit above $50k will require a short audit packet (usage snapshots + call with Helium ops). Legal prefers we add a single sentence calling out the audit packet requirement.
3) SOC2 summary is fine for procurement to start; if they request full SOC2 we’ll do an NDA first.

OK to proceed to DocuSign once Karthik confirms the final language for the escalator and the audit sentence.

—Naomi
Head, Marketplace Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@heliumanalytics.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@heliumanalytics.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@heliumanalytics.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Final private offer summary & next steps (DocuSign + AWS approval)

Sara / Tom / Daniel —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. To summarize and confirm next steps before DocuSign: 

Agreed deal skeleton:
- Term: 18 months primary (Pricing band B) with conditional upgrade to 24-month pricing band C via retrospective invoice credit if cumulative committed spend > $650k within first 12 months.
- Approvers: Sara Liu (procurement) + Daniel Park (VP Finance) on AWS approval flow; Tom Reyes as security contact.
- Compliance evidence: SOC2_summary.pdf provided. Helium may request full SOC2 under NDA; we’ll follow up separately if needed.
- Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf, private_offer_pricing_sheet.xlsx, hel-approval-roster.pdf (approver emails included).

Operational notes (from Redwood):
- Credits processed monthly, audit packet triggered for credits > $50k.
- AWS private-offer id: 0a1b2c3d (seller draft).

Next steps:
1) Daniel — please confirm whether you’ll sign or delegate; a delegation email is fine.
2) Sara — confirm if Helium legal needs a redline; if not, I’ll send DocuSign to the approver list today.
3) Once DocuSign is complete we’ll activate the private offer in AWS and route the approval to Sara & Daniel.

If I don’t hear back by EOD tomorrow we’ll send the DocuSign to the listed approvers and request expedited review.

Thanks and looking forward —
Karthik
Lead, Marketplace Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: SOC2_summary.pdf (summary), private_offer_pricing_sheet.xlsx (pricing bands/workbook), hel-approval-roster.pdf (approver emails)
